dct_description_sm:
Mapping depicts Brampton Plan Schedule 3A proposed active transportation facilities such as bike lanes, cycle tracks, buffered bike lanes,multi-use paths, shared roadways and recreational trails.

Proposed Facilities identify planned active transportation routes and infrastructure that are intended to expand Brampton’s walking, cycling, and rolling network over time. These facilities support improved connectivity between neighbourhoods, transit stations, employment areas, parks, and community destinations, helping to create a more complete and sustainable transportation system.
